Sounds of the meadow

Real recordings and openly licensed music. Music and sound effects have separate switches in the game. Your browser may need a click on Start before audio can play.

Sheep baa

“Sheep baaing 1 – Norwegian sheep expressing itself concisely” by Michael Perfect (michaelperfect). A genuine sheep field recording.
